description: Step 2 of the fz-sc8.197 page (version 3). 'extern "C" def integer + integer :: integer, as: fz_op_add_ii, raises: ...' is a clause of +/2: its declared parameter types are the clause's type test and its spec, and the selected clause is the extern. Convert the 98 one-line forwarders in lib/. The swapped-argument clauses get their own runtime entries (fz_op_*_fi). The splice's forwarder test is deleted: the question becomes 'the callee is an extern'. Measured in a spike: 46 forwarder executables leave the distiller's program; typed heads already compile identically to guards of type tests. Signal: backend program identical to step 1 except the forwarders are gone.
title: A clause can be declared as the extern it is (extern heads)
